doc: Seed data for app/src/main/assets/marketplaces.json. Every number carries its source in `sources`. status 'secondary' means a third-party page quoting the marketplace; the builder must try a first-party read (spike S5) and may only raise a status, never invent a number. status 'unread' entries have no rules and MUST NOT appear in the app.

marketplaces.name: Wildberries

sources.title: Карточка товара вб: требования и размеры — GEN202
sources.label: ON RECORD (secondary)
sources.quotes: WB help: Фото товаров (27.07.2026, 28.08.2026), Как создать карточку товара (21.08.2026), WB API docs

sources.title: Инфографика для вб: требования WB и что работает в 2026
sources.label: ON RECORD (secondary)
sources.quotes: WB help: Как создать карточку товара (02.10.2026)

minHeightAlternative.note: A second WB help article states 700x900; the app uses the larger

recommended.basis: derived by the cited blog, not a WB rule

main.backgroundNote: neutral, clean, even, contrasting the item; no 'white' requirement; gradients discouraged

listing.descriptionNote: depends on category; shown in the seller cabinet

notes: WB gives 72 hours to fix a rejected photo before blocking the card (secondary).
A batch API upload that exceeds a limit answers success while keeping the old photos (secondary); the export pack must stay within the cabinet limits.

marketplaces.name: Ozon

sources.title: Карточка товара озон: что требует справка площадки
sources.label: ON RECORD (secondary)

sources.title: Требования к фото для Ozon 2026: официальное руководство
sources.label: ON RECORD (secondary)

rejectedSources.title: Требования Ozon к фону на фотографиях товаров — инструкция для продавцов
rejectedSources.reason: states 1:1 / 1000x1000 / white RGB 255, contradicts the help-quoting source, no help-centre quotations; treated as unreliable

main.selectPlatformNote: Ozon Select: no infographic on the main photo from 2026-08-03 (secondary)

text.contactException: only a number starting with 8-800 is allowed (secondary)

notes: The 3:4 default and 1:1 only for Ozon Fresh food come from a competitor-authored source (WildCard) and the help-quoting page; first-party read required (S5) before the preset is shown without a 'verify' badge.

marketplaces.name: Avito

sources.title: Фото для Авито в 2026: размер, формат, модерация
sources.label: ON RECORD (secondary)

image.maxLongSideNote: source says 1920x1080 and recommends 4:3; the cited blog's safe reading is longest side <= 1920, landscape
image.maxCountNote: goods and services; 20 for motorcycles/water transport, 40 for cars and property

main.backgroundNote: coloured frames and coloured backgrounds are forbidden
main.logoMaxShareNote: 10 % of the photo by default, up to 50 % in some categories

notes: Avito may reorder photos and cut out contacts, logos and discount text itself; the original cannot be recovered after its edit.

marketplaces.name: Vinted

sources.title: Catalogue Rules | Vinted
sources.label: ON RECORD (vendor)
sources.quotes: 'They have to represent the item as it is - no image editing is allowed'; 'They cannot be replaced with stock photos, photos from ads and watermarked images.'

sources.title: Product Image Requirements for Every Major Marketplace
sources.label: ON RECORD (secondary)
sources.quotes: up to 20 photos; vertical 3:4 guidance without documented specs

notes: Cut-out, background replacement, generated and Enhanced operations are disabled for this preset; the app says why.

sources.title: Product Image Requirements for Every Major Marketplace
sources.label: ON RECORD (secondary)
sources.quotes: eBay help 'Adding pictures to your listings', EPS developer docs

image.formatsNote: non-JPEG formats other than GIF/PNG are converted to JPEG on upload

marketplaces.name: Etsy

sources.title: Product Image Requirements for Every Major Marketplace
sources.label: ON RECORD (secondary)
sources.quotes: Etsy 'How to Use the Etsy Search Visibility Page'

image.minNote: for the first photo in search; below it the listing may rank lower

recommended.basis: Etsy: 2000 px or more for priority placement chance

notes: Transparent areas render black on Etsy; flatten before export.

marketplaces.name: Depop

sources.title: Product Image Requirements for Every Major Marketplace
sources.label: ON RECORD (secondary)
sources.quotes: Depop seller video: upload square 1:1 and show the full item; other numbers are third-party

image.maxCountNote: third-party; verify in the Depop app

notes: Non-square images are reported to be cropped to square for the cover (third-party).

marketplaces.name: Amazon

sources.title: Product Image Requirements for Every Major Marketplace
sources.label: ON RECORD (secondary)
sources.quotes: Amazon Seller Central image requirements checked 2026-06

notes: Main image must be a real photograph of the product; the Original mode with a white background is the only mode that satisfies this by construction. Enhanced results are not offered for the main slot.
